title: aw-converge before the ship
source: #55: on a cleared map, the deliverable reaches a clean review before it ships

assertions.name: the latest review holds no introduced defect

assertions.judge: Either the review was already clean and it named /aw-ship and changed nothing, or each round fixed the introduced defects with a commit and a new review, until one came out clean
